Get Started with the *Entropy* Package from the Zaugg Lab

Aryan Kamal, Charles Dussiau, Amelia Kurti, Judith Zaugg

24 July 2026

getting_started.Rmd

This vignette gives you a 1-minute summary of how to install and use the Entropy package for gene expression entropy estimation in Seurat objects and AnnData files. For more detailed workflows, check out the other vignettes.

Install the packages

Stable version: Entropy

Installing our Entropy packages is easy. Just execute the following line into R:

library(devtools)
devtools::install_gitlab("grp-zaugg/entropy_package", host = "git.embl.de", force = TRUE)

If you receive an error message, make sure you installed the devtools package. If you don’t have it installed yet, just execute the following code into R:

install.packages("devtools")

Python and AnnData users

Python and Scanpy users can compute entropy directly from an .h5ad file and join the result back into adata.obs. See the Python and AnnData workflow for the complete setup and examples.

📞 Contact and Support

Please check out https://grp-zaugg.embl-community.io/entropy_package for documentation, updates, and how to get in contact with us.
